source.notes: ICSE Grade IX school Unit Test - I in Mathematics (school not named). Header prints 'Grade - IX', 'Sub.-Mathematics', 'Time : 1 Hour', 'UNIT TEST - I', 'MM - 20'. No year is printed; examYear 2024 is taken from the file name (icse-class-9-ut1-mathematics-030424-2024). Section A: 'Each question carry 1 mark', attempt all (8 MCQs). Section B: 'Each question carry 1.5 Marks', 'Attempt any 8 questions' of 10. The 1.5-mark questions cannot be held in the integer marks field and are separately numbered, so they are not merged: each has marks 0 (placeholder), is flagged and set LOW. Section B numbering restarts at 1, so its questions are stored as B1-B10. The scan carries a student's ticks, strike-throughs and handwritten additions (e.g. over Section B Q8), which were ignored. Notation (roots, fractions, recurring bar) rebuilt inline from the page image. No answer key is printed.
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.
